alt: Leg muscles that move the foot + toes. Anterior compartment (tibialis anterior, EHL, EDL, peroneus tertius - dorsiflexors, deep fibular nerve). Lateral (peroneus longus + brevis - eversion, superficial fibular). Posterior superficial (gastrocnemius, soleus, plantaris) + deep (tibialis posterior, FHL, FDL - plantar flexion + inversion, tibial nerve).
